BENCH_METHOD: We measured the default Explore overview and UI in a visible 1280 × 720 window on a GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA 610.47, OpenGL 3.3 Core). Each run processed 1,800 frames with VSync disabled and a fixed 1/60 s simulation step. The timed loop excludes startup and includes CPU work, rendering, buffer swaps and final GPU completion.
BENCH_INTERPRETATION: Mean frame time is elapsed time divided by frame count. At High quality, enabling Bloom added about 0.036 ms per frame in these runs. All four results exceeded the 30 FPS target on this GPU. The sub-second runs measure short-run application throughput. Results on the lab PC remain unmeasured. The companion CSV and logs preserve the command-line settings and output.
